message: みさのだいもんじ！

name: Synn
message: 「You ready?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. Keep it totally natural.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Pardon the intrusion-osaurus」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Paqy-san?」

name: Synn
message: 「Gwah!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even Sakura-kun...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Farewell, coat-tails of youth!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, hold on a second!!」
Just as I tried to make a run for it, I was grabbed by the scruff of my neck.

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Let's keep this a secret between us, okay? A secret!!」

name: Misa
message: 「If you yell that loud, people are definitely going to find out!! Just get inside!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff... I never expected you to be here, Misa. After that, I thought for sure you'd gone home」

name: Misa
message: 「I came to school for a quick errand. Dropping by here was just on the way」

name: Synn
message: 「For something 'on the way,' there sure seems to be a whole mountain of stuff piled up...」

name: Misa
message: 「Look who's talking, playing innocent and claiming you forgot something」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh」

name: Misa
message: 「Mghhh」

name: Misa
message: 「Haaah...」

name: Synn
message: 「Weren't you told to take the day off today?」

name: Misa
message: 「I know that. It's not like I can help it when I can't sit still, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha...\s02 Looks like we're both in the same boat today」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd appreciate it if you didn't lump me in with the likes of you」
Saying that, Misa headed over to the desk, when--

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo! I went and checked around the area, and there wasn't anyone in particular」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't scare me like that, Paqy...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh, honestly! I can't concentrate or get anything done while feeling so guilty」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Maybe it really would be best to just take a break like you said today, Senpai」

name: Misa
message: 「A break, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I know! Should I brew some tea or something?」

name: Misa
message: 「Unfortunately for you, I'm already covered」
Saying that, she sips from her own personal teacup.

name: Synn
message: 「...Gulp」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it? Are you saying you want some too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? No way, no way, I said I don't!!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Jeez, it's written all over your face. You really are hopeless」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I told you I'll brew it myself!」

name: Misa
message: 「I couldn't possibly leave that up to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't blame Hiss for refusing. After all, the tea Synn-sama brews is beyond awful」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It was that bad--!!」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying!? If you put it that bluntly, it's too pitiful!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... So that really is what you were thinking inside your head, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「Urk. W-W-W-Why must you twist my words in such a wicked way?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then what other reason could there possibly be?」

name: Misa
message: 「T-That's because... whenever Sakura-kun brews it, it turns out to be Japanese tea instead of black tea!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ohhh. So that's why」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. Covering for him with some lame excuse when you're just Hiss」

name: Misa
message: 「Stop trying to make me out to be the bad guy!!」

name: Synn
message: 「All right. Then let's go with black tea!」

name: Misa
message: 「Like I said, I'll do it, okay!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about this milk?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't need it!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is painful to watch...\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「Here you go」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks! Don't mind if I do. Gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp, gulp, glug」

name: Misa
message: 「Savor it a little more when you drink!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew, delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Jeez...」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious! It's delicious!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, is that so. Good for you」

name: Synn
message: 「The tea you brewed, Misa, is delicious!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I said, shut up!! Hearing flattery like that doesn't make me happy in the slightest!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's way better than when I brew it... Just what kind of magic did you use?」

name: Misa
message: 「There is a proper etiquette to it. A method someone as careless as you could never possibly imitate」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Knowing things I don't know--you're amazing, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「That was sarcasm just now, sarcasm!! Come on, fight back」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I can't think of you as anything other than amazing」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, what a pushover. Being praised by someone like that doesn't make me happy one bit」

name: Paqy
message: 「I can't bear to look...\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, Sakura-kun keeps throwing off my rhythm so much that I can't even refresh myself...」

name: Synn
message: 「Rather than refreshing, maybe relaxing would be better」

name: Misa
message: 「Relax, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「For example, taking a nice, stretched-out nap on the grass... *slurp*, delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh... didn't you drink it all earlier?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? This is the leftover batch you brewed just now, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're drinking second-steeped dregs again...!! That's exactly why I can't trust you with anything!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, relaxation. Shall we begin?」

name: Misa
message: 「Why did I even end up tagging along...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I reckon it's better than getting yelled at by Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「Taking a breather like this every once in a while isn't bad at all」

name: Misa
message: 「...There's nobody else around, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you looking around so restlessly for?」

name: Misa
message: 「Because if someone were to see us like this...」

name: Synn
message: 「What would happen?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I-I m-might be... mis... understood, or something...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misunderstood, or 'miss-undone'--what bold thing are you planning to do?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm going to sprawl out like a starfish!!」
Misa stretched her body out in desperation and fell backward.
Following her lead, I also lay down on the grass and sprawled out.
The season was autumn. Though the trees were beginning to turn brown, the sunlight was warm and pleasant.
Looking up, a cloudless blue sky stretched out above.
Misa happened to be right upwind of me.
Along with the scent of greenery, Misa's fragrance drifted over on the breeze.
The tips of her hair fluttered in the wind and brushed against my skin.
It tickled, yet it felt nice too.
Even Misa, who had been fussing earlier, was taking a deep breath of the crisp air.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, where did you go this morning?」

name: Misa
message: 「Right over there」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohh. So you went to the church. Then was that you singing that hymn earlier too, Misa?」

name: Misa
message: 「It wasn't just me, you know. Well, I was one of them, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got a really pretty singing voice, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you... it wasn't just me...」
Misa turned her back on me.
Recalling the hymn I'd heard, I tried humming it, and it actually felt surprisingly refreshing.
Tension drifted smoothly out through my nose.

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to be?」

name: Synn
message: 「I tried imitating the hymn you were singing at the church--what do you think?」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... It's completely off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「And you're terrible at it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No mercy, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「You sing it like this.」
Misa began softly singing the hymn.
A famous melody I recognized.
Matching her tone and rhythm, I joined my voice with hers.
A mixed duet―I was clearly tone―deaf, though nobody was around to care.
Once I got used to it, Misa started singing the lower harmony.
However, I was immediately thrown off by her part.

name: Misa
message: 「Geez... If you're going to sing like that, it won't sound nice at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah. Sorry.」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fine, really. Hymns are meant to be sung freely anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's impressive how well you can sing without any accompaniment~~」

name: Misa
message: 「For someone in the choir, it's only natural.」

name: Synn
message: 「The choir, huh... Maybe I should give it a try too...」

name: Misa
message: 「There aren't many male singers, so I think you'd be welcomed, though... first you need to learn how to hold the main melody properly...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... good point...」

name: Misa
message: 「Yeah... that's right...」
We're sitting together in a warm, sunny spot.
I stopped caring about thinking everything through... and lazily gazed up at the sky.
When the clouds aren't drifting, it's easy to lose track of time.

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well... I guess it can't be helped...」
Her body must have been so exhausted that she fell fast asleep the moment things went quiet.
Misa has been pushing herself hard ever since joining the Student Council, too. So, just for today--

name: Synn
message: 「If she gets mad at me, I'll deal with it then」
She'll probably tell me I'm meddling, but being careful not to wake her, I draped the jacket I was wearing over Misa.

name: Misa
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright」
Doing something a little manly has me feeling pretty pleased with myself.
It's warm today anyway, so wearing fewer layers feels just right.
Listening to the rustling of the trees, I close my eyes.
Haah... somehow I'm getting... sleepy, too... zzz.

name: Misa
message: 「How careless of me... Not only did I fall asleep before Sakura-kun, I even let him put his jacket over me」

name: Misa
message: 「...Honestly. What if Sakura-kun catches a cold from doing something like this?」

name: Misa
message: 「Not even a sign of waking up」

name: Misa
message: 「He really is sound asleep. I suppose he must have been quite tired」

name: Misa
message: 「It can't be helped... I'll let you sleep just a little longer. Here, your jacket」
Mmh... Misa's scent...

name: Misa
message: 「I'd like to repay this favor as soon as possible... I wonder if there's a good way」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmh... Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh--!? J-Just what kind of dream is he having...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way... *gulp*」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa smells so good...」
Guh, I can't, can't breathe...

name: Synn
message: 「Pwahaa--! Hah, hah... hah, hah...」

name: Misa
message: 「What kind of indecent dream were you having?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat?! I wasn't dreaming anything like that!!」

name: Misa
message: 「B-Because you were going on about how I smell and whatever...」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, that was probably... the scent on this, I think」
Saying that, he showed her the jacket.

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh. So that's what it was...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It definitely smells like you, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey... stop that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, I actually said that out loud?! Gyaaaah!」

name: Misa
message: 「So behind all that kindness, you had such impure motives... You're the woorst」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a misunderstanding! A huge misunderstanding!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hand that over right now!! I'll wash it and give it back!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, really!! You don't have to do that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if you're fine with it, it bothers me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop, you're gonna stretch it--f... f-f-achoo!!」

name: Synn
message: 「*Sniff*... hachoo!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hurry up and put it on. I don't want anyone saying you caught a cold because of me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, thanks」

name: Misa
message: 「I didn't do anything worth thanking me for!! Rather, I'm the one who--」

name: Synn
message: 「Did I do something...?」

name: Misa
message: 「You already forgot~~~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you getting mad!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm mad at how insensitive you are!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now. That's enough.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Synn
message: 「R-Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「You two sure get along well~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「What part of this looks like we're getting along?!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're even swapping uniforms with each other.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're not swapping uniforms!!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right!! Sakura-kun just draped his jacket over me, so I was only giving it back!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh~~. How sweet of you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「So you have no reason to be thanking me!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Mhm, mhm. In that case, Misa-chan's the one who should be saying thank you~」

name: Misa
message: 「T-Thank... you」

name: Synn
message: 「You're welcome...」

name: Misa
message: 「Are you satisfied now!?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait! It's not about being satisfied, I just...」

name: Misa
message: 「Then should I say it again louder so you can hear me properly!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa! Okay, I got it, I got it!」
Seriously, all I did was put a single jacket over her--why is she getting so worked up over this...

name: Ria
message: 「By the way, what did you two come to school to do?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's, uh...」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be that you came to do Student Council work?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk」

name: Ria
message: 「Juuust kidding. You were taking a proper breather, so it's fine, isn't it」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama... How could you be so kind...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Taking it easy every once in a while is pretty nice too, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「It sure is~~」

name: Misa
message: 「You're taking it way too easy. I didn't intend to doze off until this late, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then you should've just woken me up right away.」

name: Ria
message: 「I bet you were sleeping so comfortably that she couldn't bring herself to wake you. Misa-chan is kind, after all.」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Onee-sama!?」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how it was...」

name: Misa
message: 「If there's a next time, I'll wake you up immediately! Prepare yourself!!」
There's no way there'll be a next time, though if there is, I guess that wouldn't be so bad.

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, since you've probably had a chance to relax now, how about we do just a little bit of prep for Kirafes」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, are you sure?」

name: Ria
message: 「Just a tiny bit, okay」
